main.description: A user's page describing their contribution to a project.

summary.description: A short plain-text summary of the project.

thumbnail.description: The project's preview image, limited to 1 MB.

tiptapJson.description: The Tiptap document JSON. The app validates its structure and allowed nodes.

tiptapHtml.description: HTML generated from Tiptap JSON, including media. Untrusted: consumers must sanitize it and allow only supported media sources. Load model-viewer separately to display 3D.

media.description: Media referenced by the Tiptap document. Keep blob references here so files remain attached to this record. Audio-only WebM uploads may be identified as video/webm by the PDS.

descriptionFormat.description: Document format including image, YouTube, audioRecording and model3d nodes.
